player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Stormcrow''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in October 2000.

starting.card: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe

description: This deck is likely a pile, too. But what the , enjoy it. I didn't keep close tabs on the record, but through 4 or 5 tournaments, it's only lost 2 games. Oh, and it won the MN Grand Slam.
cards: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
posted: Come Here You Big Coward
notes: Starting cards as posted under '(always starting)': the Objective, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order, Visage Of The Emperor, Executor: Holotheatre and Executor: Meditation Chamber. The strategy says the third starting Effect is usually You Cannot Hide Forever, or Battle Order against quick drains (both listed under 'red'); several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
Visage Of The Emperor appears once under '(always starting)' and as 'Visage x2' under 'red', so the deck runs 3 Visage. Total 60 as published.

Secret Plans and Battle Order are the pre-Reflections III Effects, not Defensive Shields. 'Evader' dested the A New Hope interrupt Evader (not the Reflections II Evader & Monnok); 'Alter' the Dark Premiere interrupt.

Posted 'Dark Lord' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Vader w/Saber' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'GM Tarkin' Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Palpatine' Emperor Palpatine; 'Fett w/blaster' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand.

Posted 'Holotheatre'/'Meditation Chamber' dested the Executor sites; 'Death Star DB' Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'CC DB' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Its Worse' It's Worse; 'Therell Be Hell' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Weapon Lev' Weapon Levitation; 'Twilek' Twi'lek Advisor.
player_note: The post (28 October 2000) says 'through 4 or 5 tournaments, it's only lost 2 games. Oh, and it won the MN Grand Slam.' The strategy adds that the deck 'has been tweaked a bit since the first tournament I played it in', so this list may differ from some earlier events.
